description:
[writes · `stores:manage` scope] Connects a Mercatus Liber store to a brand, the same as Connect > Store in the dashboard. Send `baseUrl` (the store's https Store API URL, e.g. https://shop.example.com/api/store/v1), `apiKey` (a Store API key from the store admin) and optionally `scopes` (default ["products:read"]; add "webhooks:manage" for live sync) and `brandId` (required on an account-wide connection). The store key is checked against the store before anything is saved, stored encrypted and never returned. Calling it again rotates the store key. Needs the explicit `stores:manage` scope plus `write`; the owner must be an owner or admin of the brand's organization. Audited against this connection.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/stores/mercatus/connect.)

apiKey.description: The Store API key from the store's admin. Write-only: never echoed back.

baseUrl.description: The store's https Store API base URL, e.g. https://shop.example.com/api/store/v1.

brandId.description: The brand (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

scopes.description: What the store key was granted. Must include products:read. Default ["products:read"].

name: mercatus_store_connect
title: Connect a Mercatus Liber store
